name: Pocket Mirror
author: Divinie
description:
Pocket Mirror is a deeply relaxing game that feels calm and restful.  

Recommended Graphics Setting: Medium 

Controls: 
-Game Controllers Supported
-Mouse and Keyboard Supported                
-Press 'V' to Change View

Click sound icon on bottom right corner of this screen to enable soundtrack.                   

Thank you for playing my game!
